name: evidence.status
title: Show evidence status
summary: Verification status of a selection per view, from the evidence records and, without own record, from the children; validation status from the validation records.
details: The verification status comes from the evidence records (SR-031) and, without own record, from the children, with the children that are missing (SR-034); the validation status from the validation records (SR-038). Without a selection every element of the workspace is listed, and only requirements, needs and elements with a validation record carry a status, so select them, for example by type.

selection.description: The elements whose verification status is given: a saved filter, an inline filter, a package, a baseline or explicit IDs, optionally in the view of a variant; without it every element.

limit.description: The most elements on one page.

elements.description: One page of the selection in workspace order, each element as element.list gives it, with `verification` for every element whose type has the meaning `requirement`: its verification status (SR-031, ADR-0012 "Status rules") in each view it is in by the view rule: the core when it has no validity, each variant it is in; none for a variant that excludes or replaces it (SR-043, SR-047 AK3) or whose status the metamodel marks invalid (SR-047 AK6), and for a requirement without own verification record in a view its indirect verification from its children (`indirect`) or the children that are missing (`missingChildren`, SR-034); an element marked emergent (SR-035) is never `indirect`; and `validation`, the validation status (SR-038, `$defs/element` `validation`: every need, a requirement with a validation record). Derived from the evidence records; it is not the element's `status` and never changes it (D-030). While the metamodel is not valid the records are not compared: every requirement is `open`, every need `open`, and no other element has `validation`.

total.description: Every element of the selection, not only the page.

incomplete.description: A repository of the workspace is not available here (SR-006 AK2): its elements, and the records of its evidence locations, are missing.

names.description: The elements that `verification` names by UUID only, each once in the order first named: the variants of its views and the missing children (`missingChildren`), so a reader names them by short ID, identifier and title (ThomasBirkmaier/ReqSeq-archive#588). Left out when it names none.
